runner: Seal candidate/base/tree and explicit file hashes, clause-to-required-node mappings and security boundaries. Reject omitted mandatory nodes. time_enforcement: Before launch, atomically reserve remaining 0.1*measured-maker-active minus cumulative checker charges, startup and finalization allowances. External supervisor launches suspended worker inside Windows Job Object with kill-on-close before resume; monotonic deadline covers startup, tests, descendants and finalization. Require observed supervisor/termination margin; reserve it inside budget. Unsupported controls refuse launch.
token_enforcement: Require runtime-attested exact input including cached tokens plus server-enforced bounded cumulative output/tool-turn consumption, or exact-tokenized local inference with bounded prefill/generation. Atomically reserve every call before submission; append immutable actual receipts across children/retries. Unknown historical totals refuse measured-compliance admission. Output-only caps and startup floors are insufficient.
routing: Native subagent startup has no demonstrated hard cumulative token/deadline controls: bypass that route. No inspected runtime establishes an alternative enforceable provider cap; report capability gap without model calls. Deterministic local checks can run bounded, but cannot replace independent semantic review or issue PASS. Stage repo-local only; retain global installation.
